sourceChecks.text: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Hezekiah the king and Azariah the ruler of God’s house.

profileDecisionJa: イエヒエルは、ヒゼキヤ王と神殿の長アザリヤの任命を受け、コンヤとシメイのもとで監督者として名を挙げられます。
